title: Fire & Water Duo
description: Switch seamlessly between Fire and Water heroes to trigger color levers, cross opposing pools safely, and unlock temple exit doors together.
controls: Move, jump, and switch between the red and blue characters to solve switches and reach both temple doors.

zh-CN.title: 红蓝最强搭档
zh-CN.description: 童年封神双人解谜红蓝最强搭档：灵活切换冰火双角色互踩机关、避开相克池水收集宝石，默契配合闯关！
zh-CN.controls: 操控红蓝搭档轮流走跳踩机关，收集对应宝石并双双抵达终点大门过关。
